nl_request: Find the employees hired on or after 2024-07-19 and before 2025-08-07 who wrote legal-review notes on at least two different support cases that each have a severity of at least 3, have no closed date recorded, and belong to a customer in the west region. Return the IDs of the matching employees.
reference_sql:
SELECT e.id
FROM employees AS e
WHERE e.hired_at >= '2024-07-19' AND e.hired_at < '2025-08-07'
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.case_id)
    FROM case_notes AS n
    JOIN support_cases AS sc ON sc.id = n.case_id
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = sc.customer_id
    WHERE n.author_employee_id = e.id
      AND n.note_type = 'legal_review'
      AND sc.severity >= 3
      AND sc.closed_at IS NULL
      AND c.region = 'west'
  ) >= 2
ORDER BY e.id
